x: Vallabhaneni Sitamahalakshmi was the first woman arrested in the Salt Satyagraha in Andhra.

s: Why did the Salt Satyagraha in Rayalaseema take place at Bellary under Kalluri Subbarao?
o: The Madras Government permitted salt manufacture there
Bellary was the headquarters of the Congress
The Andhra Salt Committee was based there
x: Rayalaseema had no coast, so Kalluri Subbarao led the activity at Bellary instead of a coastal salt-making centre.

s: Who conducted the first Salt Satyagraha at Machilipatnam?
x: Ayyadevara Kaleswara Rao conducted the first Salt Satyagraha at Machilipatnam. Pattabhi Sitaramayya called Machilipatnam his ‘Mecca’.

s: Which Salt Satyagraha camp was called the 'Andhra Dandi'?
x: Seethanagaram Ashram (Brahmajosyula Subrahmanyam), the East Godavari camp, was the 'Andhra Dandi'; Devarampadu was the 'Dakshina Dandi'.

s: Which of the following pairs is NOT correctly matched?
x: Kakinada was associated with Bulusu Sambamurthy at Chollangi. Oruganti Venkatasubbayya was associated with Mylapadu in Nellore.

s: Which Salt Satyagraha camp in Andhra was called the 'Dakshina Dandi'?
x: Devarampadu near Ongole, with its camp at Prakasam's house, was the Dakshina Dandi; Seethanagaram was the Andhra Dandi.

s: Who made salt at Mylapadu in Nellore on 11 April 1930?
x: Oruganti Venkatasubbayya and Bezawada Gopal Reddy made salt at Mylapadu, Nellore, on 11 April 1930.

s: Who led the first salt squad in Madras on 13 April 1930 along with Kasinathuni Nageswara Rao?
x: T. Prakasam and Kasinathuni Nageswara Rao led the first salt squad from the Swarajya office in Madras.

s: In the Chirala and Guntur villages, who led the CDM along with Konda Venkatappayya?
x: Konda Venkatappayya and Unnava Lakshminarayana led in Chirala and the Guntur villages.

s: Who led the Salt Satyagraha at Chollangi near Kakinada?
x: Bulusu Sambamurthy led the salt satyagraha at Chollangi near Kakinada.

s: At Machilipatnam, who was injured while raising the flag at Tilak Chowk?
x: Thota Narsayya, popularly known as “Jenda Narsayya”, was injured while raising the flag at Tilak Chowk in Machilipatnam.

s: Who led the Salt Satyagraha at Visakhapatnam and Bhimunipatnam?
x: Tenneti Viswanatham led the Salt Satyagraha at Visakhapatnam and Bhimunipatnam.

s: Pattabhi Sitaramayya described which centre as his “Mecca” in connection with the Salt Satyagraha?
x: Machilipatnam was associated with Pattabhi Sitaramayya, who referred to it as his “Mecca”.

s: Which was the first Salt Satyagraha centre in Andhra, beginning on 6 April 1930?
x: Machilipatnam was the first Andhra Salt Satyagraha centre, beginning on 6 April 1930.

s: Which one of the following pairs is correctly matched?
x: Dandu Narayana Raju led the Salt Satyagraha at Mattapalem. Ravi Narayana Reddy was associated with Ramachandrapuram, Kasi Viswanadham with Vadarevu, and Pattabhi Sitaramayya with Machilipatnam.

s: Which of the following Salt Satyagraha centres in Andhra is correctly matched with its leader?
x: Bulusu Sambamurthy led at Chollangi near Kakinada; Kasi Viswanadham led at Vadarevu, Bezawada Gopal Reddy at Mylapadu and Kalluri Subbarao at Bellary.

s: Who led the Salt Satyagraha at Vadarevu on the Guntur coast?
x:
Old app notes: Kasi Viswanadham led at Vadarevu and Bulusu at Kakinada/Chollangi (NextGen p.4 also has Bulusu at Chollangi). The G2 Mains 2025 key in Carpediem gives Bulusu – Vadarevu, Kasi Viswanadham – Kakinada.
The G2 Mains 2025 key (Carpediem) matches Bulusu Sambamurty with Vadarevu, Dandu Narayana Raju with Mattapalem and Kasi Viswanadham with Kakinada, so Vadarevu = Bulusu Sambamurthy.

s: Who led the Salt Satyagraha at Mylapadu beach in Nellore district?
x: Bezawada Gopal Reddy (with Bomma Seshareddy) led at Mylapadu, Nellore.

s: Ravi Narayana Reddy led the Salt Satyagraha at Ramachandrapuram in which district?
x: Ramachandrapuram, led by Ravi Narayana Reddy, is in East Godavari.

s: Who bought the auctioned salt during the Machilipatnam Salt Satyagraha?
x: Puranam Suri Sastry bought the auctioned salt at Machilipatnam.

s: Where did Dandu Narayana Raju lead the Salt Satyagraha?
x: APPSC 2023 key: Dandu Narayana Raju - Mattapalem.

s: Who was known as 'Rayalaseema Kuruvriddhudu' and led the Salt Satyagraha at Bellary?
x: Kalluri Subbarao, called Rayalaseema Kuruvriddhudu, led the satyagraha at Bellary as Rayalaseema had no coast.

s: On which date had Thota Narsayya, known as 'Jenda Narsayya', hoisted the flag at Machilipatnam?
